checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2. Clone $TMPDIR/rv (harness) and clone $TMPDIR/probe (repeats; git status clean after each), both at 0e499f2. checks_run.expected: At least one full run exits 0. Every failure in any run is explained, and none is a product defect.
checks_run.actual:
Run 5 (unit-repeat-5.log, load 9-11): exit 0. 152 files and 2917/2917 tests pass. The formula no-codegen project passes 259, with 2 skipped. The 2 skips are by design: they are the fuzz.test.ts source-scan tests, which run in unit-node and are skipped in the NOCODEGEN project, as in rounds 1-5.

Three loaded runs exit 1, so the no-codegen project did not run in them (the root script chains it with &&):
- the harness run (unit-node22.log, load 25-33, 1408 s instead of about 4 min): 3 failed / 2914 passed;
- repeat 1 (load 15-32): 6 failed / 2911 passed;
- repeat 3 (load 20-23): 2 failed / 2915 passed.

Every failure is one of two kinds:
(a) A first-render findBy that misses the harness's 5 s asyncUtilTimeout: raid.test.tsx:236, g1-agreements.test.tsx:129, p2-blank-forms.test.tsx:146, prioritization.test.tsx:112/144 and traceability ('Assign initiative'). Each is the first test of a describe, where the lazy page chunk is transformed.
(b) architecture.test.ts at its 30 s test timeout, plus one vitest RPC 'Timeout calling onTaskUpdate' unhandled error in the harness run and in repeat 1.

None of them is the F-DG4-106 test: Y1c passed 6/6 in every run.

Why these are timeouts and not defects:
- Re-run alone at load about 23 (unit-failed-specs-alone.log), architecture passes 138/138. The (a) specs still miss 5 s for their first test.
- With a scratch config that only lengthens the wait (asyncUtilTimeout 25 s, testTimeout 60 s; probe clone only, reverted), all 90 tests of raid, prioritization and p2-blank-forms pass. The failing tests took 8.5-15.2 s. The unchanged control at the same load fails the same 4 (unit-timeout-discriminator.log).
- They pass in the clean runs 5 and 6.
The pages render, only slowly under 5-8× CPU oversubscription. These specs did not change since round 5, and I raise no finding.

checks_run.procedure:
Verify F-DG4-106 adversarially, in three parts.
(A) Append my round-5 probe, unchanged, to the new spec. Run it with every round-5 hold (detail, summary, audit, decisions, /me, POST) at 2200 ms and at 4500 ms.
(B) Mutate api/client.ts in the probe clone so the product sends a /me it must not (M1), or omits a required one (M3), plus the equivalent mutants M2 and M4.
(C) Run the full pnpm test 8 times under the concurrent load (see SEC-R6-07/08).
checks_run.command: bash probe-y1c.sh; bash probe-y1c-m4.sh; unit-repeat.sh; unit-repeat-b.sh
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2 for A and B. Disposable probe clone $TMPDIR/probe at 0e499f2; each mutation was reverted, and git status was clean afterwards. Load 10-30.
checks_run.expected: (A) Exactly 2 /me in every case. (B) M1 and M3 fail Y1c; unmutated passes. (C) Y1c never fails.
checks_run.actual:
(A) 12/12 cases give '/me after POST = 2' and pass, each exit 0. In round 5, the summary and audit holds gave 3 and failed (round-5/probe-Y1c-timing-node22.log).

(B)
- M0, unmutated: 6/6 pass.
- M1, window ignored: 4 failed / 2 passed, exit 1. Y1c and the window-crossing case fail in EN and AR. The 2 passing tests are the 'not visible to the creator' cases, which count no /me.
- M3, never revalidate: the 2 window-crossing cases fail, exit 1.
- M2 and M4 (stamps and single flight removed) pass 6/6. The runner is queryClient.fetchQuery(keys.me), which joins an in-flight /me (App.tsx:110-112), so the wire behaviour is identical. These are equivalent mutants, not a test gap.

(C) Y1c and the window-crossing case pass 48/48 across 8 full runs, including at load 34.

F-DG4-106 is CLOSED_VERIFIED (verifications sidecar). The 6 probe-log failure lines are exactly the mutation runs M1 (4) and M3 (2), by design.

checks_run.procedure: Discriminate a slow render from a missing render for the specs that still failed alone under load. In the probe clone only, lengthen asyncUtilTimeout from 5 s to 25 s and testTimeout from 20 s to 60 s, run raid, prioritization and p2-blank-forms, then revert and run the unchanged control at the same load.
checks_run.command: bash unit-timeout-discriminator.sh; bash unit-failed-specs-alone.sh
checks_run.environment: Node 22.22.2 (discriminator); Node 22 and 24 (alone). Probe clone $TMPDIR/probe; git status clean afterwards. Load about 23.
checks_run.expected: With the longer wait the tests pass, which shows slowness rather than a defect.
checks_run.actual:
Longer wait: 3 files and 90/90 tests pass. The previously failing tests take 8.5 s (p2 gate submission note), 14.4 s (prioritization ranked table), 5.9 s (scorecard) and 15.2 s (raid action register).

Control, unchanged config: the same 4 fail at 5.3-9.6 s with 'Unable to find …'.

Alone on Node 22: g1-agreements 10/10, traceability 32/32 and architecture 138/138 pass. raid (1), prioritization (2) and p2-blank-forms (1) fail by timeout.
Alone on Node 24: g1, traceability, p2 52/52 and architecture pass. raid (1) and prioritization (1) fail by timeout.
